name: ansaribradley
expr: [h1, p1, s1] = ansaribradley(a1, b1); [h2, p2, s2] = ansaribradley(a2, b2); [h3, p3, s3] = ansaribradley(a3, b3); [h4, p4, s4] = ansaribradley(a4, b4); [hr, pr, sr] = ansaribradley(a4, b4, 'Tail', 'right'); [hl, pl, sl] = ansaribradley(a4, b4, 'Tail', 'left'); [h5, p5, s5] = ansaribradley(a5, b5);
comment: Sig: [h, p, stats] = ansaribradley(x, y[, alpha or name-value]). Non-parametric two-sample scale test. V-shape Ansari ranks min(i, N+1-i) with mid-ranks for ties. W = sum of ranks for x. Exact path (min(m,n) ≤ 10): DP-enumerate C(N,m) permutations, scaled by LCM of tie-group sizes for exact integer arithmetic. Asymptotic path (else): conditional-permutation moments E[W] = m·mean(r), V[W] = mn/(N-1)·σ²(r) — automatically handles ties via observed ranks. Tail convention is INVERTED (MATLAB-specific): 'right' = dispersion(x) > dispersion(y) ⇒ W small ⇒ p = P(W ≤ obs); 'left' = opposite. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on all probe cases (asymptotic + exact + tied + tails) at 1e-9 tolerance. Full production: no GAPs.
